Subject: Invoice consolidation & ledger migration for renewal

Hi Sophia,

Congrats again on the renewal — excited to keep supporting GreenGrid. Following our procurement thread, we need to align on how you want the renewal invoice and the end-of-term true-up routed across your three legal entities (GreenGrid US Inc, GreenGrid Ltd UK, GreenGrid EU SARL) now that you're migrating ledger ownership into a central AP flow.

Key asks from our side to finalize the invoice cutover:
- Confirm PO numbers and the invoice remit entity for each PO (attached: GreenGrid_PO_list.csv).
- Confirm VAT treatment for each entity (reverse-charge vs. standard VAT, and which entity will self-account).
- Indicate whether you want a single consolidated invoice with internal split lines (Redwood issues one invoice and you allocate internally) or separate invoices per legal entity.
- Any required VAT certificates or tax ids we should reference on the invoices (attach them if convenient).

If you prefer a single invoice with our internal split, we'll produce a consolidated PDF (preview attached) and include an Excel allocation that your AP can use to post to separate ledgers. If you prefer separate invoices, we will generate three legal invoices and apply the appropriate VAT routing per entity.

Attached: GreenGrid_PO_list.csv (PO numbers & entity mapping). I also attached an example invoice_preview_Q4.pdf for the consolidated approach.

Can you confirm preferred approach and timelines? We aim to issue the final invoice the week of Oct 5 to meet your quarter-end close.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Marcus — thanks, and congrats to the team too.

Short answers to your bullets: we prefer separate legal invoices per entity for audit clarity, but we need Redwood to apply the following rules when issuing:
1) GreenGrid Ltd UK (UK VAT reg. GB123456789): standard VAT on UK-recognized services — please add GB VAT on the UK invoice.
2) GreenGrid EU SARL (FR VAT reg. FR99887766): we will self-account under reverse charge — reference our VAT id and include the reverse-charge note.
3) GreenGrid US Inc (EIN 12-3456789): no VAT, remit to our US treasury bank (IBAN not applicable).

Attached is a scanned VAT cert for the EU entity (vat_certificate_GG-UK.pdf — odd name but it includes both UK and EU certs) and a single csv with updated PO->entity mapping (see inline notes).

Also: our AP team prefers invoices to include the PO on the invoice header and to list line-item allocations by subscription period (your preview PDF looks good). If possible, please set the invoice due 30 days from issue and send to billing@greengrid.com with Monica copied.

We’ll need final invoices by Oct 8 to process in our Oct month-end run.

Best,
Sophia Martinez
Head of Procurement | GreenGrid Health
sophia@greengrid.com

Thanks for the clear guidance, Sophia — that works. Action plan from Redwood:

1) We will issue three separate legal invoices, one per legal entity, with the PO reflected on the header. Each invoice will show the subscription lines and the portion of the renewal/true-up allocated to that entity.

2) VAT handling per your notes:
   - GreenGrid Ltd UK: apply UK VAT; reference GB123456789.
   - GreenGrid EU SARL: apply reverse-charge note and include FR99887766 on invoice.
   - GreenGrid US Inc: no VAT, invoice in USD to US treasury remit.

3) Invoice deadlines: Redwood to produce draft invoices and the allocation workbook (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) by COB Thu Sep 24 for a quick 24-hour review, then final signed invoices issued Oct 6 to meet your desired Oct 8 processing.

4) Sign-off: please confirm we can send the draft to billing@greengrid.com; if OK, we’ll route the finals via DocuSign for your AP sign-off (link included in metadata).

Monica (cc’d): can you prepare the invoice templates and attach the draft PDFs and the allocation workbook by tomorrow morning? I’ll follow up with a short checklist in thread.
